# Patent investigation search record

Research date: 2026-09-09. Public web search and direct document review. No confidential brief text was uploaded to a patent-search service. Queries used public identifiers and general technical terms.

## Main source locations

The report links each patent record and primary paper next to its analysis. Claim text was reviewed for P1–P12 at the level described in the report. This is not a complete claim-by-claim chart of every independent/dependent claim or descendant.

Priority CPC search areas identified in reviewed records: H04L9/32, H04L9/0894, H04L63/08, H04L63/0884, G06F21/31 and G06Q20/38. **A systematic classification search was not completed.** These are next-search inputs, not a claim of coverage.

## Failed or incomplete retrievals

- Google Patents URLs US12671588B1 and US20260162161A1 failed. Corresponding Justia texts were recovered. The attempted USPTO `image-ppubs.uspto.gov/dirsearch-public/print/downloadPdf/12671588` endpoint failed. Official corroboration remains open.
- Google US8281149B2 failed; parent claims recovered on Justia, secondary status from the US9154306 family table.
- EPO Register direct/Espacenet application routes for EP21808374 and EP20729321 failed. National Swedish and UK legal status was not established.
- EP3932037B1 direct retrieval failed; family lead retained from US12050679, without treating its claims as reviewed.
- LU101620 direct retrieval failed; family lead retained from Microsoft records.
- EUR-Lex CELEX/ELI returned minimal pages without usable substantive text. EU Publications Office indexing corroborates the record, not the detailed legal requirements.
- Original SSRN direct open failed initially; web search returned the original abstract. Full text not analysed.

## Coverage limits and update procedure

No commercial patent database, authenticated official dossier, certified register extract, prosecution-history analysis, ownership/licence verification, SEP declaration search or litigation search was completed. No assertion of exhaustive geographic/family coverage is made. Expired/abandoned/withdrawn secondary labels must be rechecked before relying on them.

To update: confirm product flow and markets, obtain official current granted claims for each priority family, expand family/citation/classification searches, chart each potentially relevant independent claim against the complete system, record absent/present/disputed elements, assess equivalents and territorial acts with counsel, and refresh shortly before launch. Search newer applications again as the publication window advances.
